title: Afternoon Sunwatch
text:
☀️ Afternoon Sunwatch — November 10, 2026

🔆️ Solar activity: Moderate (C1.2)
🔥 Latest solar flare: C2.2 (Peaked November 10, 2026 at 18:18 UTC)
💨 Solar wind speed: 589 km/s (Fast)
🌎 Geomagnetic activity: Unsettled (Kp 3.00)
🚨 NOAA Alert: Electron 2MeV Integral Flux exceeded 1,000pfu

Space weather is feeling a little breezy today. 🌀🌎👀

Several active regions are bright and well-defined today, with multiple sunspot groups visible across the solar disk.

Image: NASA SDO/AIA — 304/211/171 Å Composite
Data: NOAA Space Weather Prediction Center
